sections.title: Mission
sections.content: The Cathedral Network provides free, transparent, probabilistic early warning for humanitarian threats. We serve the vulnerable first, always.

sections.title: Founder
sections.content: Built by a former homeless addict, the Cathedral is proof that those with nothing can build anything. The Silence Clause protects the identity behind the inscription, because the work is bigger than any one person.

sections.title: Governance
sections.content: The Cathedral is governed by a written Constitution with Fifteen Immutable Laws, including the Justice Filter (Law I), Human Authority (Law II), Trust Through Accuracy (Law III), the Perpetual License (Law V), the Founder's Temporary Authority (Law VI), the Financial Firewall (Law VII), Capture Prevention (Law VIII), Ground-Reach (Law IX), Outlasting the Builder (Law X), Bicameral Governance (Law XI), Data Privacy (Law XII), the Diplomatic Guild (Law XIII), Integrity (Law XIV), and the Witness Must Speak (Law XV). The Silence Clause protects the identity behind the inscription in perpetuity.

sections.title: License
sections.content: All Cathedral code and content is licensed under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 – free to share and adapt, non‑commercially, with attribution. This license is irrevocable and embedded in the Constitution (Law V).

sections.title: Join Us
sections.content: The Cathedral is open‑source, community‑driven, and built for the vulnerable. Explore the Threat Matrix, read the Prediction Log, or become a Warden.
